chunks: Aḥmad ibn Mihrān, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī, from Fuḍayl ibn ʿUthmān, from Ṭāhir, who said:
I was seated in the presence of Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, when Jaʿfar عليه السلام came forward, so Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام said: “This is the best of creation.”

key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar, the Imam in whose presence the narrator was seated
key_terms.جَعْفَرٌ: Jaʿfar, identified here as the one being praised
key_terms.خَيْرُ: the best; indicating superiority and excellence

ai.seo_question: What does al-Kāfī narrate about the virtue and rank of Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a statement of Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام praising Jaʿfar عليه السلام with an expression of great virtue and distinction. In context, it serves as a biographical and theological indication of the lofty rank of Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام.

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Mihran, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Fuzayl Bin Usman, from Tahir who said,

‘I was seated in the presence of Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, so he<sup>asws</sup> kissed Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> and Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘This one<sup>asws</sup> is the best of the Created beings’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ahmad ibn Mihran has narrated from Muhammad ibn Ali from Fudayl ibn ‘Uthman from who has said the following.
“Once I was in the presence of abu Ja‘far (a.s.) that Ja‘far (a.s.) came. Abu Ja‘far (a.s.) said, “This (Ja‘far) is the best of the people.”
